verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־ גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yaḵ dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·yaḵ·nî·‘êm way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- gaṯ ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . David defeated the Philistines subdued them and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines

verses.original: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֑ב וַיִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ way·yih·yū mō·w·’āḇ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wîḏ nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh
verses.literal: David also defeated the Moabites and they became subject to David and brought him tribute

verses.original: וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ- ṣō·w·ḇāh ḥă·mā·ṯāh bə·leḵ·tōw lə·haṣ·ṣîḇ yā·ḏōw bin·har- pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: As far as Hamath David also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kōḏ dā·wîḏ mim·men·nū ’e·lep̄ re·ḵeḇ wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm pā·rā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš raḡ·lî way·‘aq·qêr dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·re·ḵeḇ way·yō·w·ṯêr mim·men·nū mê·’āh rā·ḵeḇ
verses.literal: David captured from him a thousand chariots seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers and he hamstrung . . . all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַעְז֕וֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’ă·ram dar·me·śeq la‘·zō·wr la·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh way·yaḵ dā·wîḏ ba·’ă·rām ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah David . . . struck down twenty-two . . . thousand of their men

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem dā·wîḏ ba·’ă·ram dar·me·śeq way·hî ’ă·rām lə·ḏā·wîḏ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh lə·ḏā·wîḏ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wîḏ ’êṯ šil·ṭê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer hā·yū ‘al ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer way·ḇî·’êm yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem

verses.original: וּמִטִּבְחַ֤ת וּמִכּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד בָּ֣הּ׀ עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־ יָ֤ם הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ וְאֶת־ הָֽעַמּוּדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·miṭ·ṭiḇ·ḥaṯ ū·mik·kūn ‘ā·rê hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer lā·qaḥ dā·wîḏ nə·ḥō·šeṯ rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ bāh ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- yām han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm wə·’êṯ kə·lê han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: And from Tibhath and Cun cities of Hadadezer David took a large amount of bronze with which Solomon made the bronze Sea the pillars and various bronze articles

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔יד אֶת־ כָּל־ חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ צוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ tō·‘ū me·leḵ ḥă·māṯ kî hik·kāh ḏā·wîḏ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥêl hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ- ṣō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת־ הֲדֽוֹרָם־ בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִיד לִשְׁאוֹל ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וְכֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- hă·ḏō·w·rām- bə·nōw ’el- ham·me·leḵ- dā·wîḏ liš·ʾōl lōw lə·šā·lō·wm ū·lə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ‘al ’ă·šer nil·ḥam ba·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer way·yak·kê·hū kî- ’îš mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ tō·‘ū hā·yāh hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer wə·ḵōl kə·lê zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: he sent his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer who . . . had been at war with Tou Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze

verses.original: גַּם־ אֹתָ֗ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ō·ṯām hiq·dîš ham·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ Yah·weh ‘im- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer nā·śā mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim mê·’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·mim·mō·w·’āḇ ū·mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mip·pə·liš·tîm ū·mê·‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: and King David dedicated these to the LORD along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations from Edom and Moab and from the Ammonites . . . Philistines and Amalekites

verses.original: וְאַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת־ אֱדוֹם֙ בְּגֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·šay ben- ṣə·rū·yāh hik·kāh ’eṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·ḡê ham·me·laḥ šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen . . . thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽאֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm nə·ṣî·ḇîm way·yih·yū ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wîḏ way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wîḏ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: He placed garrisons in Edom and all the Edomites were subject to David So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖יד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lōḵ dā·wîḏ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh ‘al- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- ’ă·ḥî·lūḏ maz·kîr
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder

verses.original: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְשַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār kō·hă·nîm wə·šaw·šā sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests Shavsha was the scribe

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־ הַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵי־ דָוִ֥יד הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים לְיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ‘al- hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî ū·ḇə·nê- ḏā·wîḏ hā·ri·šō·nîm lə·yaḏ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side
